title: 4BR Beach Side Vacation Home on 30A with a Private Pool
meta_description: Stay at Sublime, a 4BR, 4BA, 30A vacation home with a private heated pool, outdoor grill, a porch, and an upgraded kitchen. Sleeps 10 guests.
description_expanded: Located in beautiful Seagrove Beach, just off Scenic 30A between Seaside and Rosemary Beach, this newly updated 4-bedroom beach house offers the perfect blend of Southern charm and modern comfort. With 3 full and 2 half baths, it’s designed for relaxed coastal living, whether you’re sipping coffee on the porch or unwinding by the pool.Step inside to find fresh updates, including new flooring throughout the downstairs, a beautifully upgraded kitchen with new countertops and cabinets, and fully renovated bathrooms with stylish new finishes. The fresh interior paint enhances the home’s bright and airy feel, making every space more inviting.Surrounded by lush trees on a naturally wooded lot, this home provides a private retreat while keeping you close to everything 30A has to offer. Start your mornings with a short bike ride to Seagrove’s charming cafés, grab the perfect pastry at a local bakery, or explore the coastal dune lakes just minutes away. Spend the afternoon lounging on the sugar-white sand beaches, paddleboarding in the Gulf, or browsing the boutiques and art galleries in nearby Seaside.After a day of adventure, return to your private pool area (with optional heat) to cool off, then gather on one of the spacious porches to watch the sunset with a glass of wine. The top-level tower offers a cozy sitting area alongside the 4th bedroom, making it a great space to relax with a book or take in the treetop views.Seagrove Beach:Named for the thick grove of oak trees lining its coastline, Seagrove Beach is located in the heart of 30A. There's no better spot to experience everything 30A has to offer! Feeling adventurous? Rent a bike and jump on the 20-mile Timpoochee bike trail that runs right around the corner from the neighborhood. Visit famous Seaside and Grayton Beach State Park to the West. Head East and discover more of Seagrove Beach plus the wonderful coastal communities of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Enjoy exploring the boutique shops, fabulous restaurants, and beautiful state parks in each of these communities.Your stay at Sublime comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Pool heat can be added for an additional fee* Parking for 4 cars.* Sorry, no pets allowed.An initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
